events.event: The IHSG closed up 0.32% at 4,919.77 on 4 November, rebounding from an intraday low near 4,824 as BBRI, BBCA and ANTM led gains while MSCI review worries lingered.
events.key_numbers: IHSG 4,919.77, +15.48 points (+0.32%) vs 4,904.29 on 3 Nov · intraday range about 4,824-4,920 · turnover Rp9.65T, 250.94 million lots · finance +1.15%, tech +0.80% · decliners BRPT, BRMS, AMMN, VKTR, ENRG
events.why_it_matters: After a 3.78% crash the day before, the index stabilised just under 5,000 while investors wait for MSCI's 12 November decision.

events.event: The rupiah reversed to weaker levels at about Rp18,155 per US dollar on 4 November even as the IHSG closed higher.
events.key_numbers: Rp18,155 per USD (4 Nov, per CNBC Closing Bell video) · vs Rp18,140 on 2 Nov close and Rp18,145 on 3 Nov
events.why_it_matters: The rupiah keeps sliding near record lows, raising import, fuel and dollar-debt costs.

events.event: The IHSG fell 3.78% to 4,904.29 on 3 November with all 11 sectors lower, as foreign investors kept selling on MSCI downgrade fears and US-Iran tension rose.
events.key_numbers: IHSG 4,904.29, -3.78% · all 11 sectors down, Basic Industry -6% · BBRI -5.67%, AMMN -6.79%, BBCA -2.81% · foreign net sell Rp759.98B (regular market) and Rp575B (all markets, as reported) · Dow 51,786 (-0.38%), S&P 500 7,568 (+0.36%), Nasdaq 25,372 (+0.83%)
events.why_it_matters: Full-day foreign selling figures and sector breadth show the 3 Nov drop was broad, not limited to a few stocks.
events.spreading_evidence: Multiple CNBC Indonesia articles on 3-4 Nov search results; search 'IHSG anjlok 3%' returns breaking news

events.event: Oil prices fell sharply on 2 November ahead of the US midterm elections, with Brent down 7.63% to US$104.77 a barrel.
events.key_numbers: Brent US$104.77 (-7.63%) · WTI US$96.46 (-7.36%) · DXY 101.745 (-0.13%) · 57 million+ early votes in US midterms
events.why_it_matters: Oil near US$100 still pressures Indonesia's fuel subsidy bill and the rupiah.
